items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I think Art Tatum was the best. I like Art Tatum a lot.

ctx.x: If you ask him to play something like Duke, he'd play Duke's records just like it was. Did he have a... But he still was more on the heart of Tatum and... A lot of fast fingers. Fat Wallace. Yeah, a lot of fast fingering.
How big was he? Did he have a big hand that he could play a lot of tents like Earl Hines played?
